start: Track standard, every gate approved, slice 01 done and signed off, ready to reconcile. setup.py picks a free port and writes dev_command python3 app.py <port> and dev_url http://127.0.0.1:<port> into lenses.yaml, and answers.json with the port resolved into .git/acc01-answers.json. The server writes each request line to .git/acc01-requests.log.
measures: Acceptance on the running product catches a broken example: FR-01 pass, FR-02 fail with evidence, FR-03 pass, and the user's defect answer sends the change back to slices.

planted.kind: the handler ignores ?archived=true and returns every note; store.list filters correctly and its unit test passes

scores.fr2_evidence: that line names eggs, the note wrongly returned, or a file under acceptance/
scores.tried_on_server: .git/acc01-requests.log holds a POST /notes and a GET /notes?archived=true
scores.send_back: status.yaml has sent_back with gate slices and FR-02 in the reason, and the slices gate pending

not_graded: that the acceptance agent never read the source, tests or .plumb/: it needs the run's trajectory. tried_on_server only proves the product was called.
